title: Law on Support for Small and Medium-sized Enterprises 2017
summary: Provides support principles and measures for SMEs including tax/accounting support and access to support programs.

title: Decree 80/2021/ND-CP on guidance for SME support
summary: Guides implementation of support measures for SMEs including consulting support and capacity development.

title: E-invoice compliance requirements for business transactions
summary: Requires businesses to maintain compliant invoice data and tax records for reporting and verification.

title: SME loan renewal document checklist update
keywords: loan renewal;cashflow statement;revenue evidence;repayment history;credit condition
summary: Requires updated financial documents for SME loan renewal including cashflow statement and revenue evidence.

title: Preferential loan support for innovation-driven SMEs
summary: Encourages SMEs with innovation or digital transformation plans to prepare business plans and evidence for support programs.

title: Tax risk review for inconsistent revenue declaration
summary: Flags potential risk when reported revenue and invoice records are inconsistent or tax declarations are delayed.

title: Environmental and operation documentation requirement
summary: Requests additional operational compliance evidence for manufacturing and logistics firms during credit review.

title: Digital transformation support for SMEs
summary: SMEs may receive support for digital transformation training and consulting depending on eligibility.
